name: com.photonvrplus.core
description: Photon VR Plus: a rebuilt, drop-in replacement for PhotonVR (fchb1239). It covers Photon PUN 2 VR networking for Gorilla Tag-style games: App ID + Voice App ID settings, Photon Voice, a networked player prefab with Head/Face/Body/LeftHand/RightHand cosmetic slots, smooth head/hand sync, reconnects and room helpers. It keeps the original class names, fields and cosmetic keys. Requires PUN 2 and Photon Voice 2 from the Asset Store, plus TextMeshPro.

author.name: Photon VR Plus contributors (original PhotonVR by fchb1239)
